map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.monster.treasu: Kiri swordsmen guard a blade they looted from Uzushio long ago: Hiramekarei, the twin sword of the Seven. Gaara's road is sealed by Kiri chakra, and only a Kiri blade can cut it.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.pandora.red: The Uzumaki sealing masks still hold the chakra of the clan. It flows into you.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.monster.treasu: Kiri swordsmen guard the Scroll of Seals of the Uzumaki clan, taken when Uzushio fell. The seal on Naruto's road is an Uzumaki seal, and only this scroll can undo it.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.pandora.blue: The Uzumaki sealing masks still hold the chakra of the clan. It flows into you.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.uzumaki.f: An Uzumaki seal bars the road: a wall of red script that burns at a touch. It was written with the Scroll of Seals, and only that scroll can undo it. The scroll lies on Gaara's road.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.uzumaki.n: The Uzumaki seal still burns. Bring the Scroll of Seals from Gaara's road: your heroes can meet through the stone circles and trade.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.uzumaki.c: Naruto unrolls the Scroll of Seals. The red script reads itself backwards and fades. The scroll crumbles to dust.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.mist.firs: A seal of Kiri water chakra bars the road, a wall of mist that closes again behind every blow. Only a Kiri blade can cut it: Hiramekarei, which lies on Naruto's road.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.mist.next: The mist seal still holds. Bring Hiramekarei from Naruto's road: your heroes can meet through the stone circles and trade.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.mist.comp: Hiramekarei splits into its twin blades and cuts the mist in two. The seal is gone, and so is the sword, back into the mist it came from.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.raids.fir: The masked man's stone circle. It is sealed and still gathering chakra; it will wake on day 10.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.raids.nex: The stone circle is still sealed. It will wake on day 10.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.sand.firs: The shrine of the Uzumaki: the masked man's seal covers its door. Two locks glow on it, one of sand and one of Uzumaki script. The sand lock answers only to the chakra of a jinchuriki of the sand: Gaara.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.sand.next: The sand lock waits for Gaara.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.sand.comp: Gaara lays his hand on the lock. The sand in it remembers Shukaku and crumbles away.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.spiral.fi: The second lock is Uzumaki script, the clan's own seal turned against it. It answers only to Uzumaki blood: Naruto.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.spiral.ne: The Uzumaki lock waits for Naruto.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.gate.spiral.co: The script knows Naruto's chakra. The spiral on the door turns once and opens. Below, the Three-Tails roars.
Isobu, the Three-Tails, rises in the masked man's chains, maddened by the seal, and attacks!
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.header.name: Naruto: The Uzumaki Spiral
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.header.descrip:
Co-op for two players (red and blue are allies). The ruins of Uzushiogakure, the whirlpool village of the Uzumaki clan, lie on an island built as the clan's double spiral. Yagura, the Fourth Mizukage, puppet of a masked man, holds the temple at its heart and is binding Isobu, the Three-Tails, with the clan's own seals. Naruto lands on the north-west shore, Gaara on the south-east. Each spiral road is shut by seals whose keys lie on the other road: work together. Stone circles join the two roads.

Win: defeat Isobu in the shrine at the centre. Lose: Naruto or Gaara falls, or day 43 comes.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.header.author: Naruto Heroes
Uzushiogakure. Naruto and Gaara land on opposite shores of the spiral island. Tsunade's orders: "Yagura holds the temple at the centre, and the masked man is chaining the Three-Tails with the Uzumaki seals. In six weeks Isobu will be his weapon. Each of your roads is sealed, and the keys lie on the other road: help each other. The stone circles on your roads lead to each other's."
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.event.keys.mes: An old Uzumaki inscription on the shore: "The guardian of each road lets through whoever has visited the tent of its colour, and once it has let one through, it is gone for all." Naruto's road is guarded in green, and the green tent stands on Gaara's road. Gaara's road is guarded in purple, and the purple tent stands on Naruto's.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.event.supplies: Supply boats arrive from Konoha and Suna.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.event.raids.me: Scouts report: the masked man's stone circle in the temple has woken. From now on Kiri's hunter-nin step into it and come out on your roads, past the first seals. Guard your mines, and your towns once the green and purple guardians are gone.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.event.material: Tsunade and the Kazekage's council send rare materials.
Three weeks are gone. The chains on Isobu tighten: three weeks left.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.event.lastWeek: One week left! On day 43 the binding will be complete.

map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.header.rumor.0: They say Kiri destroyed Uzushiogakure because it feared the Uzumaki seals.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.header.rumor.1: The Fourth Mizukage has strange eyes these days, the fishermen say: red, with a pattern in them.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.header.rumor.2: Monkey King Enma once trained in the caves of Uzushio, the old tales say.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.header.victory: Isobu is free of the masked man's chains.
Isobu falls, and the masked man's chains break with him. The Three-Tails sinks back into the sea, free. Yagura wakes from his long dream. Uzushiogakure is silent again: mission complete!
Naruto has fallen. Without Uzumaki blood the shrine will never open. The mission has failed.
Gaara has fallen. Without him the sand lock will never open. The mission has failed.
Day 43: the binding is complete. Isobu rises from the sea as the masked man's weapon. The mission has failed.
map.naruto-uzumaki-spiral.header.defeatM: Lose Naruto or Gaara, or let day 43 come
